description: This Python source file defines a caching handler class for managing cache interactions specific to large language model (LLM) API requests, including methods for retrieving and setting cache entries asynchronously and synchronously. It handles various cache types, converts cached data into appropriate response objects, and updates logging environments accordingly. The class is used within a larger LLM framework to optimize API call efficiency by leveraging multiple cache backends.

classes.name: CachingHandlerResponse
classes.description: Response object for caching handler, encapsulating cached results and embedding responses, with flags indicating cache hits.

classes.name: LLMCachingHandler
classes.description: Main class managing cache retrieval and storage for LLM API requests, supporting both async and sync operations, cache type handling, and response conversion.

methods.name: _async_get_cache
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves cache data based on call type and parameters, returning a structured response or None.

methods.name: _sync_get_cache
methods.description: Synchronously retrieves cache data based on call type and parameters, returning a structured response.

methods.name: handle_kwargs_input_list_or_str
methods.description: Ensures the 'input' in kwargs is returned as a list, whether originally a string or list.

methods.name: _extract_model_from_cached_results
methods.description: Extracts the model name from a list of cached embedding results.

methods.name: _process_async_embedding_cached_response
methods.description: Processes cached embedding responses, assembling final response and cache hit flags.

methods.name: combine_usage
methods.description: Combines two Usage objects by summing their token counts.

methods.name: _combine_cached_embedding_response_with_api_result
methods.description: Merges cached embedding response with new API response, updating timing and usage info.

methods.name: _async_log_cache_hit_on_callbacks
methods.description: Logs cache hit success asynchronously and updates logging environment.

methods.name: _retrieve_from_cache
methods.description: Internal method to get cache data asynchronously, supporting multiple cache backends.

methods.name: _convert_cached_result_to_model_response
methods.description: Converts cached raw data into appropriate model response objects based on call type.

methods.name: _convert_cached_stream_response

methods.name: async_set_cache

methods.name: _should_store_result_in_cache
methods.description: Determines if a result should be stored in cache based on call type and cache settings.

methods.name: _is_call_type_supported_by_cache
methods.description: Checks if the original function's call type is supported by the cache.

methods.name: _add_streaming_response_to_cache
methods.description: Adds completed streaming response to cache asynchronously.

methods.name: _sync_add_streaming_response_to_cache
methods.description: Adds completed streaming response to cache synchronously.

methods.name: _update_litellm_logging_obj_environment
